retries.reason: attempt1 round keep; attempt2 drum/octagonal tower

stonehold_sequential_gate_section_plan_v.notes: Attempt1 rejected: plus-shaped courtyard and single-chamber cutaway, not outer to passage to inner. Retry PASS: horizontal wall band with two barrier planes and longitudinal tunnel section. Road markings look modern; rebuild as packed basalt. Sequence does not replace the technical plate or gate_stonehold_faultline.

stonehold_sequential_wall_module_kit_v00.notes: Attempt1 rejected: timber barn doors and climbable rubble at wall-end. Retry PASS: three isolated front elevations, one leaf pair, cliff seating without a ramp. Leaves still show X-brace; Blender rebuilds as layered dark-iron plates. One pair only, not outer+inner twins.

stonehold_walltop_defender_modules_v001.notes: Attempt1 rejected: lava at base and outer-face ladder. Retry PASS: cold merlon elevation, inner-side stair module, blank outer face. Left panel is an inner-face elevation rather than a true walk plan; rebuild walk from 2.4 m width intent.

stonehold_fortress_plan_apron_v001.notes: Attempt1 rejected: 3/4 axonometric, stairs into apron, central fountain. Retry PASS: near-ortho polygonal plan, one flush gate, empty dashed apron, flag as circle+mast-dot, low keep roof. Apron pixels are not the 30 m metric; fortress contract remains fail-closed.

stonehold_fortress_elevations_v001.notes: Attempt1 rejected: round drum keep, compact gatehouse not a perimeter. Attempt2 rejected: still a drum/octagonal tower. Attempt3 PASS: low rectangular keep behind a one-gate wall, front+side, no talus/stairs. Compact length; instance curtain wall from the plan, not from pixels.

stonehold_fortress_keep_flag_anchor_v001.notes: Keep roof plan, low-broad front, isolated 6 m flag mast with empty socket and mannequin. Extra plinth views are the same object. No cathedral, no second gate.

stonehold_terrain_geology_worldscar_v001.notes: Left geologic cut is still somewhat bedded; right Worldscar brink has macro/meso/micro fracture, mannequin, no cones, no lightning/magma. Rebuild strata as nonperiodic offset blocks, not a layered cake.

stonehold_terrain_route_bed_rocks_v001.notes: Attempt1 rejected: metal tram rails, 3/4 slab, egg-smooth scaled rocks. Retry PASS: rut depressions in section, packed-ash top-down with stone shoulders, angular player-scale rocks + mannequin.

stonehold_ecosystem_family_orthos_v001.notes: Attempt1 rejected: FractureFan as vertical crystal palisade. Retry PASS: sedge clump, fern mass, ironbell bush, lower radiating fan, talus pile, mannequin. Fan still slightly crystalline; rebuild as low broken-fan fins. Ironbell is a bushy bell cluster, not fence posts.

stonehold_ecosystem_composition_plots_v0.notes: Four isolated 8 m elevation strips: exposed ridge, sheltered fault, route verge with clear lane, Worldscar exposure. Grounded volumetric clumps, no stick/spike/fence drift, no animals.

stonehold_interior_guard_forge_rooms_v00.notes: Two true top-down furnished plans. Guard: racks, desk, stair, door swing, 1.2 m walls. Forge: two anvils, quench, packed-fuel bunker not lava, wagon doors, stores, circulation. Slight wall-top 3/4; not a dollhouse cutaway.

stonehold_interior_service_civic_rooms_v.notes: Service/stores with racks, cistern, crates, counter, aisles. Civic chamber with table, chairs, steward desk, shelves, door swings. Complete walls, no fake shells, no readable writing.

stonehold_civic_props_orthos_v001.notes: Eight isolated civic furnishings + 1.8 m mannequin. Blank notice board. Embermist timber/basalt/iron. Slight 3/4 on objects; not a room collage.

stonehold_fort_props_orthos_v001.notes: Eight isolated fort furnishings: single cot not bunk, empty rack, one crate, gate-control empty sockets, mannequin. Locker door slightly modern; rebuild as timber/iron. No weapons, no collage.
